checks.description: Four visible, named mode tabs
First opening selects Track of the Day
Daily scenic route preview is rendered
Embedded scenic artwork is applied by the browser
Car selector opens as a modal
All seven cars available in the selector
Selected car updates daily view
Daily best and record are scoped to selected car
Race preview carries selected car
All five red lights illuminate before release
Five red lights extinguish at the start
Race-start preview returns to an actionable menu button
Preview returns to originating race page
Weekly track selection changes Race destination
Weekly Race opens selected track
Track search matches creator names
Biome filtering combines with search
Weekly track selection is retained across modes
Search is retained across modes
Favorites combine with active search and biome filter
Removing the last favorite gives a recoverable empty state
Clear filters restores the full demo catalogue
Random opens a track preview
Discover shows the three challenge formats
Challenge retains its pinned car despite a different general car selection
Joining a challenge adds it to Joined
3×3 creation uses the three fixed demo tracks
3×3 creation fixes three tries per track
Creation opens the Created folder
Created title is rendered as text, including markup characters
Arrow keys navigate and activate focused mode tabs
End key selects the final tab
Last mode is remembered for the browser session
